$comment: Tolerance policy of the Secrets quality gate: one entry per tolerated gitleaks finding over the history reachable from HEAD, identified by commit, file, rule, line and column. Every entry is a security finding and carries the explicit human decision that tolerates it. Changed only by a reviewed change approved as ADOPTION-PLAN.md; a run never rewrites it. Read by scripts/test-runner/secrets.ts.
